steps.label: repair-node-table
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE PropNodes(Id INT64 NOT NULL) PRIMARY KEY(Id)

steps.label: repair-view
steps.sql: CREATE VIEW VolatileView SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS SELECT n.Id, GENERATE_UUID() AS V FROM PropNodes AS n

steps.label: repair-graph-default
steps.sql: CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH Volatiledefault NODE TABLES(VolatileView KEY(Id))

steps.label: repair-read-default-1
steps.sql: GRAPH Volatiledefault MATCH(n) RETURN n.Id AS id,n.V AS v ORDER BY id

steps.label: repair-read-default-2
steps.sql: GRAPH Volatiledefault MATCH(n) RETURN n.Id AS id,n.V AS v ORDER BY id

steps.label: repair-graph-false
steps.sql: CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH Volatilefalse NODE TABLES(VolatileView KEY(Id)) OPTIONS(allow_view_with_volatile_column=false)

steps.label: repair-read-false-1
steps.sql: GRAPH Volatilefalse MATCH(n) RETURN n.Id AS id,n.V AS v ORDER BY id

steps.label: repair-read-false-2
steps.sql: GRAPH Volatilefalse MATCH(n) RETURN n.Id AS id,n.V AS v ORDER BY id

steps.label: repair-graph-true
steps.sql: CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH Volatiletrue NODE TABLES(VolatileView KEY(Id)) OPTIONS(allow_view_with_volatile_column=true)

steps.label: repair-read-true-1
